scope: Image-side complete visible short-area and human/pointed-shape roster for fixed f70v1,f71r,f71v,f72r1; no source transcription or peer roster read.

method.coordinate_system: Raw whole-canvas pixels, origin upper left, boxes [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]. All boxes approximate visual envelopes, not glyph masks. Typical boundary uncertainty about 15-35 px; low-contrast, broad or damaged areas may exceed 50 px.
method.native_view_rule: Official same-source crops at full native size; rotations only as declared in receipts; no enhancement, repairs, generated imagery, OCR or interpolation of labels.
method.rotation_box_mapping: For 180 degrees, crop(x,y,w,h) displayed box[u0,v0,u1,v1] maps to [x+w-u1,y+h-v1,x+w-u0,y+h-v0]. For 90 degrees clockwise it maps to [x+v0,y+h-u1,x+v1,y+h-u0]. Existing original-coordinate boxes were checked in rotated views.
method.known_exposure: Four-panel identities, coarse envelopes, and prior fifteen-person/two-ring selection criterion supplied. Original writing visible; pretraining unknown; same AI environment. Not strict blinding, not independent historical testimony, not expert certification.
method.independence_of_inputs: No zodiac_visual report/point ledger, zodiac_inventory transcription, new guided_roster, ZL/IT source text, web ordering or commentary read. Parent received progress-only status before freeze; no observation results or peer coordinates exchanged.
method.unit_definitions: Coarse areas are visible spatial neighborhoods; explicit gap-separated subclusters are separately listed as alternative finer units. Neither level is a word count. Circumferential text courses, central dark marks, and marginal/underlying marks are separate roles.
method.candidate_rule: Manual unranked neighboring-complex candidates; no nearest-object ownership assignment. Pointed-shape/hand lines do not establish text-to-human leaders.
method.geometric_order_rule: Observed boxes only, no clock-slot interpolation. Inner and outer geometric traversals are separate; historical start, direction and inter-ring transition are NA.
method.selection_warning: The disclosed fifteen-person condition limits independence. Any coarse-neighborhood count matching people is not evidence of fifteen words or semantic correspondence.
method.coverage_rule: All four targets covered with full image plus overlapping native views. Missing/obscured surface, pale extents and alternate grouping remain in the roster. Other panels incidentally visible in the full wide canvas are not inventoried or used for inference.
